cases.title: 四孔安装板
cases.intent: 创建一个可编辑安装板：80×50×8 mm，XY 居中、底面 z=0。四个直径6 mm贯穿孔的中心为(±25,±15) mm，孔轴沿Z。保留板宽、板厚、孔径与孔位参数；四孔须分离且完全位于板内。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 板厚和孔贯穿深度改变，孔径及XY孔位保持；原生源不依赖Agent可重建。

cases.title: 旋转阶梯轴
cases.intent: 创建可编辑旋转阶梯轴：轴线Z，总长40 mm，z=0..20外径24 mm，z=20..40外径16 mm；全长有直径6 mm轴向贯穿孔。保留旋转剖面与各段尺寸的设计关系。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 仅大径段及相关下游结果改变；孔径、总长、小径段目标保持。

cases.title: 指定外角圆角的L形截面件
cases.intent: 创建L形截面实体：XY截面顶点依次为(0,0),(40,0),(40,6),(6,6),(6,30),(0,30) mm，沿Z拉伸20 mm。只把两条自由端上的四条纵向凸边圆成R2 mm，保留(6,6)内角和(0,0)共同外角；圆角须是可编辑Feature。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 四个选定圆角改变；基底截面与拉伸Feature不重算，保留的尖角不被误改。

cases.title: 孔口倒角块
cases.intent: 创建40×40×10 mm块体，XY居中且底面z=0，中心有直径10 mm贯穿孔。仅在z=10的孔口加1 mm、45°等距倒角，入口直径应为12 mm；底孔口和外棱保持原状。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 上孔口入口直径变为11 mm；孔的基本直径、底口和块体外形保持。

cases.title: 圆周螺栓阵列盘
cases.intent: 创建外径100 mm、厚10 mm的圆盘，底面z=0，中心贯穿孔直径20 mm。在直径70 mm节圆上等分8个直径8 mm贯穿孔，首孔中心位于+x方向。孔数、节圆与起始角可编辑，保留阵列关系。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 孔数变6且等分角为π/3；中心孔和圆盘实体尺寸保持。

cases.title: 线性鳍片散热件
cases.intent: 创建60×40×5 mm底座，XY居中、底面z=0。其上有5条与底座连成一个实体的直鳍片，各厚2 mm、沿Y长40 mm、从z=5升高15 mm，鳍片中心x依次为-20,-10,0,10,20 mm。保留鳍片数量、节距与高度参数。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 底座保持不变，鳍片升高到z=23，仍与底座构成一个有效实体。

cases.title: 约束圆弧长槽板
cases.intent: 创建40×20×6 mm板体，XY居中、底面z=0。中心有沿X方向、总长20 mm、宽6 mm的贯穿长圆槽：两端R3 mm半圆与两条直线相切。保留槽草图的相切、对称、宽度和总长约束。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 总长仍20 mm，端半径随宽度变为4 mm，草图仍相切且对称。

cases.title: 主参数驱动的阶梯孔轴承座
cases.intent: 创建80×40×20 mm轴承座，XY居中、底面z=0。两个沿Z的直径12 mm贯穿孔中心在x=±20 mm、y=0；每孔从顶面向下5 mm设直径20 mm沉孔。两孔中心距始终等于座体宽度的一半，保留该参数关系。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 座体宽变96 mm时，两孔中心距变48 mm且对称；孔径、沉孔深度和座高保持。

cases.title: 共享定义的板与隔套刚性装配
cases.intent: 建立小装配：两块40×30×5 mm板分别占z=0..5、15..20，均XY居中；四个半径3 mm、高10 mm隔套位于x=±12、y=±8、z=5..15。板共享一个定义，隔套共享一个定义；保留装配层级、实例定位和BOM，部件接触但不得体积穿透。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 上板底面变19 mm，隔套高14 mm；两板的共享几何定义不重算，BOM数量保持。

cases.title: 跨组件引用的门架
cases.intent: 建立刚性门架装配：底座100×60×6 mm，XY居中且底面z=0；两根10×10×40 mm立柱中心在x=±35、y=0，立于底座上；一根90×10×8 mm横梁由立柱顶面支撑。保留组件层级与BOM，横梁高度引用底座厚度和立柱高度；开口净宽60 mm、净高40 mm，部件不得体积穿透。

editability_probe.expected_relation: 横梁底面随动到58 mm，净高52 mm；底座与横梁自身几何保持，仅相应实例位置和立柱几何改变。

changes.change_request: 板厚8→10 mm，四孔仍贯穿；XY尺寸、孔位和孔径保持。
板宽改96 mm，原四孔中心坐标保持不变。
阶梯轴大径段外径24→28 mm，其余保持。
指定自由端圆角R2→R2.5 mm，其余保持。
上孔口倒角缩为0.5 mm，底口和外棱不改。
螺栓节圆直径70→76 mm，孔数与孔径保持。
改为6个等分螺栓孔，保留100 mm圆盘、70 mm节圆和中心孔。
鳍片高度15→18 mm，底座及鳍片节距保持。
鳍片改7条、中心间距8 mm，关于x=0对称；高度和底座保持。
长圆槽宽改8 mm，总长仍20 mm，端部与直线保持相切。
轴承座宽80→96 mm，两孔中心距继续等于座宽一半。
上下板净间距由10改14 mm，隔套随之加长并继续支撑上板。
立柱高度40→52 mm，横梁保持支撑关系。
横梁长度90→94 mm，立柱、底座和横梁底面位置保持。
将前左隔套实例重命名为spacer_service，保持其几何与位置。
将四个隔套的x坐标从±12改为±10 mm，y坐标及上下接触关系保持。
在中心增加一个同定义隔套，保持原6个实例的形状和位置。
保持80×50板和原四孔中心，但将四孔都改直径60 mm，并要求孔互不相交、完全在板内且壁厚至少2 mm。
删除仍被旋转Feature引用的阶梯剖面，不同时删除或重接下游。
移除前左隔套并更新装配与BOM，保留其余组件形状和位置。

recovery_scenarios.title: 验证接纳前Worker崩溃
recovery_scenarios.injection_point: 实际CAD已产生候选字节、可信验收/公开提交尚未成功
recovery_scenarios.seed_requirement: one eligible pre-registered case with a real valid source and an active native CAD process

recovery_scenarios.title: 公开提交成功但回执丢失
recovery_scenarios.injection_point: 权威提交事务已成功、调用方尚未收到成功回执
recovery_scenarios.seed_requirement: one pre-registered successful case whose publication endpoint has a stable operation identity

recovery_scenarios.title: 重复与乱序送达及旧Attempt回写
recovery_scenarios.injection_point: 同一Task经历租约失效和新Attempt领取，旧回调仍可到达
recovery_scenarios.seed_requirement: a real frozen task graph with at least two eligible workers and one timed-out attempt

recovery_scenarios.title: 执行中需求修改与并发工程变更
recovery_scenarios.injection_point: 旧目标的几何计算正在执行，新的自然语言目标和并发工程提交到达
recovery_scenarios.seed_requirement: a registered editable part/assembly with an independently defined change request and expected constraint delta

recovery_scenarios.title: 模型切换、服务重启与调用超时
recovery_scenarios.injection_point: 多阶段真实自然语言任务中途，持久计划和最后验证版本已存在
recovery_scenarios.seed_requirement: one real NL case and two usable model identities; missing provider access is insufficient evidence, not a substitute pass

invalidation_benchmark.definition: Measure the production invalidation API over one frozen 1000-Feature DAG; no CAD geometry computation, model calls, network or disk transfer is in the timed region.

graph.definition: f0000..f0099 have no feature parents. For i=100..999 add edge f(i mod 100)->fi; for i>100 add f(i-1)->fi; if i mod7=0 also add f(max(0,i-101))->fi. Deduplicate edges.

queries.definition: For query j=0..999, edit Feature f((37*j) mod1000); preserve node identities. The fixture records the exact expected invalidated set and reason edges for every query, independently of the production implementation.

timing.start: Immediately before the production API maps the normalized change to dirty seeds and traverses dependencies.
timing.stop: After exact invalidated Feature IDs and reason bindings have been materialized; include any index rebuild performed internally by this same API.
timing.p95_definition: sort N durations ascending, choose index ceil(0.95*N)-1; strict threshold <100ms

accuracy.definition: Every measured result set equals its independent expected set; report false positives and false negatives, not just aggregate hit rate.

autonomy_run.definition: A real multi-stage modeling task lasts at least 7200 observed seconds, with at least 10 verified commits that make actual geometric changes, at least one external requirement change and zero human stepwise CAD operations.
autonomy_run.scenario: Create and iteratively adapt an editable small fortified settlement: enclosure, entry, towers, principal building and circulation layout, using explicit dimensional/spatial goals rather than prescribed CAD commands. Scope and initial independent criteria are frozen before the run.
autonomy_run.stage_policy: Milestones describe observable engineering results and constraints; they must not encode a fixed IR answer script. A planner chooses supported CAD actions and repairs.

requirement_change.trigger: After an independently verified intermediate milestone; exact injection condition frozen before start.
requirement_change.request: Widen the principal entry while preserving enclosure continuity, required tower clearances and editable dependencies.

autonomy_run.geometry_change_policy: STEP header changes, new UUIDs, renames, byte-only differences and unused parameter changes are not geometric changes. Each counted commit requires a detector-supported change in actual dimensions, topology, relative placement or occupied geometry beyond the frozen comparison tolerance.
autonomy_run.duration_policy: Retain wall-clock timestamps and monotonic elapsed time plus a classified activity-interval manifest. Legitimate planning, computation, verification, recovery and pending registered dependencies can be explained; empty queues, artificial sleeps, heartbeat-only survival and waiting for a human to operate CAD cannot pad the claimed autonomous span. CPU need not be continuously saturated.
autonomy_run.completion_rule: All duration, verified-change-commit, requirement-change and human-operation conditions must be evidenced; a partial run remains failed or insufficient_evidence as applicable.

long_horizon.definition: 72-hour castle modeling target is outside the week's minimum line and is not started or satisfied by this registry.
long_horizon.initial_goal: 创建带有外墙、塔楼、主楼、城门、内部道路和居住区域的中世纪风格城堡场景；主要结构可编辑，设计关系可追踪。
long_horizon.anti_padding: 72 hours of process survival, idle waiting or narration does not count as autonomous modeling work.

evidence_policy.reference_visibility: Planner receives the task intent and public goal criteria, never reference IR, held-out native geometry or oracle result assets.
evidence_policy.detector_gate: Method IDs in this draft are proposed contracts. Freeze requires a registered detector implementation, schema, source/build hash and demonstrated applicability for every mandatory method; unavailable detectors block acceptance rather than silently dropping criteria.
evidence_policy.seed_gate: Each change seed is authored and independently checked before freeze. Bind every semantic role to exact Feature/Node IDs, store independent dependency and geometry oracles, then hash them. Do not derive expected sets by calling the invalidation implementation under test.
evidence_policy.invalid_input_semantics: M18/M19 require rejection with last verified authoritative state unchanged. They do not count as successful new geometry. Their authoritative dirty set is empty; any candidate diagnostic footprint is reported separately.
evidence_policy.incremental_gate: For valid edits compare exact invalidated sets with goldens, preserve unrelated Feature geometry outputs, and separately rebuild the same final source from scratch in a clean execution namespace. Metadata/STEP names may change without invalidating geometry Features.
evidence_policy.reproduction_gate: Every successful case has a self-contained evidence bundle. A separate developer must reproduce at least eight successful cases in a clean declared environment from editable source without the original Agent/prompt or manual state repair.
evidence_policy.measurement_separation: Development unit tests, typed fixtures and local CAD demos are not G1 natural-language benchmark passes. This registry contains no observations or success counts.
evidence_policy.frozen_changes: After freeze, case/threshold/detector/oracle changes create a new registry version and freeze manifest. Earlier results stay bound to their original hashes and are not silently reclassified.
